critical_code_review_comments: server.py:441-447 update_water_point returns find_one({...}, {'_id':0}) — correct, no ObjectId leak.
server.py:433-438 create_water_point returns 'doc' which is built before insert_one (spread copy avoids mongo inserting _id back into the returned dict). Good pattern.
server.py:477-480 seed_water_points is idempotent (only seeds when collection empty). Safe against restart.
WaterPointsEditor.tsx:82-87 nearest-sector reducer works but overrides label/lat/lng from the point's own coords; UX is fine because the closest chip visually matches. Non-blocking.

route/[id].tsx:69-73 buyPoints filter merges buy_point_ids with custom points within 5 km of any path node using distanceKm — correct behavior; verified visually with 'Locales de Rano Raraku' appearing on rano-raraku-tongariki.
